description: This is a FastAPI backend server script for 'Resume Insights Platform' API. It defines API endpoints for user authentication, resume upload and management, AI analysis triggering, and retrieving analysis feedback and summaries. The file imports modules for database interaction, AI service usage, file handling, and authentication, and sets up API routes with detailed documentation and background processing for AI resume analysis.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify API is running.

methods.name: register_user(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, creating user record and returning auth token.

methods.name: login_user(user: schemas.UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: User login endpoint to authenticate and generate access token.

methods.name: upload_resume( file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Resume file (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT)"), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint for uploading resume files, saving to disk and creating database record.

methods.name: list_user_resumes( current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieve list of resumes uploaded by the current user.

methods.name: get_resume( resume_id: int, current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Get details of a specific resume.

methods.name: delete_resume( resume_id: int, current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Delete a resume and its associated file.

methods.name: run_analysis_background(resume_id: int, db: Session)
methods.description: Background task to perform AI analysis on a resume and store results.

methods.name: trigger_analysis( analysis_request: schemas.AnalysisCreate, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API to start analysis on a resume with background task delegation.

methods.name: get_analysis_results( resume_id: int, current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieve the latest analysis results for a resume.

methods.name: get_feedback_summary( current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Summarize feedback and trends across user's resumes.
